title: Historic Atlas — Explore places through time
features: Stone-and-amber map/list homepage with search, period filters, marker details, local role controls, create/edit location form and keyboard-accessible mobile navigation.
limits: Static frontend adaptation of a server-rendered Next.js specification. Original schematic map, not Leaflet or geographic tiles; fictional records. Role switch is not authentication. Edits live only in memory; no API, CSRF, translations service or server observability is claimed.
